artboards.title: Option B — Out on the Field

annotations.text:
HOMEPAGE — Option A, Club Green

A sliver of the club photo under the header, a short introduction with the events button, then straight into news.

The introduction is a placeholder for you to write. Everything in [square brackets] is a placeholder — news titles, dates and authors come live from Spanner.

The current site, for comparison.

Opens with an <h1> that says "Home", everything at one size on one white slab, and news posts render full-length so one long one buries the rest.

The two directions not taken, kept for reference.

B led with a full-bleed photo hero; C dropped the hero entirely and ran news beside a sidebar.
